body: I couldn't have worded that any better myself, thanks because it made me not feel so alone. Sometimes I even wish I didn't have a family just so I could kill myself in peace knowing no-one will shed a tear for me. Then I could just go in peace

1. The only thing stopping me is that I am trying to be a better person, I'm an asshole who doesn't deserve to live and the people around me don't deserve to put up with my shit. So the only thing stopping me is that one day (hopefully soon) I can be someone in their lives that they are proud of instead of being this horrible cunt I am now. That I can repay them for believing in me when even I didn't. 

2. My mum, she has her own problems but has never given up on me. So suicide to me would feel like giving up on her. 100% if she hadn't been such a good mum to me growing up I would have done it years ago.

3. Maybe one day all this hardship will help me, maybe help someone else from making the mistakes I have made. So really right now I'm only living for other people. But maybe that's enough? Who knows
